id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

subjectCount.description:
The total number of subject objects that this route captures.
This field is not eligible to be used in a {@link FetchSpec#filter}.

model.description:
The model that this route predicts on.
There is a dual dependency between {@linkn MlModelUi.Route} and {@link MlModel#routes} for convenience.

project.description:
The project that this route belongs to. This can also be available on {@link MlModelUi.Route#model#project} but is
represented here for convenience.

subjectFilter.description: The filter that this route predicts on.

created.description: Information about who created the route and when

trainedMetadata.description:
Metadata about the training run, if this pipeline is trained.
Null if not trained.

uiSubjectFilter.description:
Represents how the UI wants to filter {@link MlModelUi.Route} with regards to subjects.
The UI has the option to filter by `subjectFilter` OR by an individual subject id.
ModelOps.RoutesFilterPanel will structure that filter value as
['subjectFilter', '"country == 'GER'"] OR ['subjectId', 'windturbine_1'] where the
first index determines what kind of filtering should be applied and the second index
determines the filter value.
When it is passed to the backend the structure is stringified.
This field merely exists for documentation for the filterPanel to put these values on a field
for filtering purposes with `fetch`.
It will never be returned on a {@link MlModelUi.Route#fetch} or {@link MlModelUi.Route#from}
but it can be included in {@link FetchSpec#filter} of {@link MlModelUi.Route#fetch}.

title:
Ui representation of {@link MlModel.Routes}.
The {@link #id} of this {@link MlModelUi.Route} is the same as the corresponding {@link MlModel.Route}.
